name: Returning Home
summary: In Darnassus, Returning Home brings young night elf priests before the leaders of their faith. After proving themselves in Teldrassil’s wilds, they are summoned to the Temple of the Moon to meet Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

sections.title: A Summons from Darnassus
sections.body: Priests tending the wounded and cleansing corruption around Dolanaar draw the Sisterhood of Elune’s notice. Trainer Laurna Morninglight intercepts promising initiates with word that Priestess Alathea has asked to meet them. Aid to local settlements matters, but each devotee must also deepen their communion with the Moon Mother and answer the faith’s higher calling.

sections.title: Within the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: The road leads from Teldrassil’s boughs to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The sanctuary rises above the city in Elune’s gentle glow. It is the kaldorei’s chief house of worship and spiritual capital. An invitation into its halls means an initiate is recognized by the priesthood’s leaders, no longer treated only as a young student.

sections.title: The Favor of Tyrande and Alathea
sections.body: Priestess Alathea greets returning initiates warmly. She says she and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind take pride when initiates venture into the uncertain world and return unharmed. This homecoming begins deeper sacred trials under Alathea’s direct guidance.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Returning Home?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight, the priest trainer in Dolanaar, summons young night elf priests after they gain enough training and experience.
Priestess Alathea is in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, near the center of the night elf capital on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Priestess Alathea want to see me?
aliases: why go to temple of the moon
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune’s elders have noticed your service in Teldrassil’s wilderness. Alathea believes you are ready for advanced instruction and greater spiritual duties.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: is returning home for all classes
faq.answer: No. Only night elf priests receive this summons as part of their early training and initiation into the Sisterhood’s higher duties.
After you report to Priestess Alathea, she gives you Stars of Elune to undertake next.

faq.q: What is the Temple of the Moon's significance to night elves?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon is Elune’s chief house of worship. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides the Sisterhood and the kaldorei nation from there.

angles.text: As a priest, you are answering a summons that marks your passage from forest acolyte to servant of the Sisterhood of Elune, called to Darnassus.
As a kaldorei, you answer the Temple of the Moon’s call and renew your ties to your people’s traditions under the watch of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.
